name: CADEX
verdict: A product brand of Giant Group (Giant Manufacturing), a listed Taiwanese bicycle maker (TPE: 9921). Nothing found.
note: Giant's high-performance components brand (wheels, cockpits); on the Liv AlUla Jayco 2026 jersey sleeve. Giant Group's corporate site lists CADEX among its product brands (giantgroup-cycling.com, opened 2026-10-03). No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against CADEX or Giant found in the sources checked (2026-10-03).
